steps.text: 請揀一段你最有代表性的經歷，講講你具體負責甚麼，結果如何。
steps.followUp: 如果要用一個數字說明結果，會是甚麼？
steps.textEn: Tell me about one of your most representative experiences. What were you specifically responsible for, and what was the result?
steps.followUpEn: If you expressed the result with one number, what would it be?
steps.textYue: 可唔可以揀一段最能代表你嘅經歷，講下你具體負責啲咩，同埋結果點樣？
steps.followUpYue: 如果用一個數字講個結果，會係幾多？

steps.text: 你的 CV 上哪一項技能，最能幫你勝任這個職位？可以舉一個用過它的例子嗎？
steps.followUp: 你會怎樣繼續提升這項技能？
steps.textEn: Which skill on your CV would most help you succeed in this role? Can you give an example of using it?
steps.followUpEn: How would you continue to improve this skill?
steps.textYue: 你份 CV 有邊項技能最幫到你勝任呢個職位？可唔可以講個用過佢嘅例子？
steps.followUpYue: 你會點樣繼續提升呢項技能？

steps.text: 可以講一次你在團隊中處理意見分歧的經驗嗎？
steps.followUp: 如果重來一次，你會怎樣做得更好？
steps.textEn: Tell me about a time you handled a disagreement in a team.
steps.followUpEn: If you could do it again, what would you do better?
steps.textYue: 可唔可以講一次你喺團隊入面處理意見分歧嘅經歷？
steps.followUpYue: 如果再做一次，你會點樣做得更好？

steps.text: 講一次你趕不及限期的經歷，你當時怎樣處理？
steps.followUp: 之後你改變了甚麼做法，避免再發生？
steps.textEn: Tell me about a time you missed a deadline. How did you handle it?
steps.followUpEn: What did you change afterwards to prevent it happening again?
steps.textYue: 講一次你趕唔切限期嘅經歷，你當時點樣處理？
steps.followUpYue: 之後你改咗啲咩做法，避免再發生？

steps.text: 講一次你收到負面意見的經驗，你怎樣回應？
steps.followUp: 那次意見最後帶來了甚麼改變？
steps.textEn: Tell me about a time you received negative feedback. How did you respond?
steps.followUpEn: What changed as a result of that feedback?
steps.textYue: 講一次你收到負面意見嘅經歷，你點樣回應？
steps.followUpYue: 嗰次意見最後帶嚟咗啲咩改變？

steps.text: 如果你負責的推廣活動第一週數據很差，你會先看哪些指標，下一步做甚麼？
steps.followUp: 你會怎樣向上司匯報這個情況？
steps.textEn: If the first week's results for a campaign you manage were poor, which metrics would you look at first and what would you do next?
steps.followUpEn: How would you report the situation to your manager?
steps.textYue: 如果你負責嘅推廣活動第一個星期數據好差，你會先睇邊啲指標，下一步做啲咩？
steps.followUpYue: 你會點樣同上司講呢個情況？

steps.text: 如果兩位上司同時給你緊急任務，而你只能先完成一項，你會怎樣處理？
steps.followUp: 你會怎樣跟另一位上司溝通？
steps.textEn: If two managers gave you urgent tasks at the same time and you could only finish one first, what would you do?
steps.followUpEn: How would you communicate with the other manager?
steps.textYue: 如果兩位上司同時畀你緊急任務，而你只可以先做完一項，你會點樣處理？
steps.followUpYue: 你會點樣同另一位上司溝通？

steps.text: 香港的五年規劃提出發展國際金融、貿易和創新科技等中心。你應徵的職位所在的行業，未來幾年可能因此出現甚麼新機會或新要求？你會怎樣準備？
steps.followUp: 可以舉一個你已經開始準備的具體行動嗎？
steps.textEn: Hong Kong's five-year plan proposes developing international finance, trade and innovation centres. What new opportunities or requirements might this create in your target industry, and how would you prepare?
steps.followUpEn: Can you give one concrete action you have already started?
steps.textYue: 香港五年規劃提出發展國際金融、貿易同創新科技等中心。你應徵職位所在嘅行業，未來幾年可能有啲咩新機會或者要求？你會點樣準備？
steps.followUpYue: 可唔可以講一個你已經開始準備嘅具體行動？

steps.text: 政府推出 AI 技能提升計劃。你認為 AI 工具會怎樣改變這個職位的日常工作？你會怎樣提升自己？
steps.followUp: 有沒有一個你用 AI 工具完成工作的例子？結果如何？
steps.textEn: The government has introduced an AI upskilling programme. How might AI tools change the daily work in this role, and how would you develop your skills?
steps.followUpEn: Can you give an example of work you completed with AI tools and the result?
steps.textYue: 政府推出 AI 技能提升計劃。你覺得 AI 工具會點樣改變呢個職位嘅日常工作？你會點樣提升自己？
steps.followUpYue: 有冇一個你用 AI 工具做嘢嘅例子？結果點樣？

steps.text: 如果公司計劃參與北部都會區大學城一帶的產學合作項目，你應徵的職位可以怎樣支援？
steps.followUp: 你會先了解哪些資料，才提出建議？
steps.textEn: If your company planned an industry-university collaboration near the Northern Metropolis University Town, how could your target role support it?
steps.followUpEn: What information would you look into before making a recommendation?
steps.textYue: 如果公司打算參與北部都會區大學城附近嘅產學合作項目，你應徵嘅職位可以點樣幫手？
steps.followUpYue: 你會先了解邊啲資料，先至提出建議？

steps.text: 政府推出三萬青年職位及實習計劃。如果你得到其中一個實習機會，頭三個月你會怎樣證明自己的價值？
steps.followUp: 你會用甚麼指標說明你的成果？
steps.textEn: The government has introduced a programme for 30,000 youth jobs and internships. If you received an internship, how would you demonstrate your value in the first three months?
steps.followUpEn: Which measures would you use to show your results?
steps.textYue: 政府推出三萬青年職位同實習計劃。如果你攞到其中一個實習機會，頭三個月你會點樣證明自己嘅價值？
steps.followUpYue: 你會用啲咩指標講清楚你嘅成果？
